==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
* As an English and Scottish surname, from the obsolete noun {{m|en|low|t=mound, barrow|id=mound}}.
* Also as an English and Scottish surname, from the adjective {{m|en|low}}.
* Also as an English and Scottish surname of {{der|en|nrf|-}} origin, from {{der|en|xno|leu|t=wolf}}.
* Also as a Scottish surname, from a pet form of {{m|en|Lawrence}}. Compare {{m|en|Lowry}}.
* As a {{der|en|de|-}} and Jewish surname, variant of {{m|en|Löwe}}, {{m|en|Lowe}}, {{m|en|Loew}}.
* As a {{der|en|zh|-}} surname, variant of {{m|en|Lau}}, {{m|en|Lou}}; also {{m|en|Li}}, {{m|en|Luo}}.

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|~|s}}

# {{surname|en}}.
# {{place|en|twpmun|in|rcomun/La Vallée-de-la-Gatineau|r/Outaouais|p/Quebec|c/Canada}}, named after Charles Adamson Low.
# {{place|en|ghost town|co/Tooele County|s/Utah|c/USA}}.

====Derived terms====
* {{l|en|Balian-Low theorem}}
* {{l|en|Gell-Mann and Low theorem}}
* {{l|en|Low basis theorem}}
* {{l|en|Lowville}}

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Low'' is the 2979<sup>th</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 12032 individuals. ''Low'' is most common among White (61.77%) and Asian/Pacific Islander (28.82%) individuals.
